trigger: Independent reviewer bc-846df7da rejected shiji:027:r0003 and identified idiomatic 將亡 misread (see independent-editorial-review.md).
sourceZh: 縮，其國有憂，將亡，國傾敗。

parallelPattern.note: Same omen-series grammar; 將亡 is future auxiliary + 亡, not 將 as general.

literal.before: Contraction, its state has worries, will perish, state collapse and fail.
literal.ownerNote: Independent reviewer accepted keeping literal without importing 將 as general; no owner-proposed literal edit.
literal.spellingCheck: Consider optional future copy-edit for parallel articles (the state will collapse) only if reviewer wants; not staged as accepted.

idiomatic.before: If there is contraction, that state will have worries, the general will perish, and the state will collapse and fail.
idiomatic.after: If there is contraction, that state will have worries, is about to perish, and the state will collapse and fail.
idiomatic.reason: 將亡 reads as auxiliary 將 + 亡 (about to perish), parallel to 國傾敗; 將 is not the noun general here.
